methodology: CPU measurements use two paired runs per version, in before/after/before/after order. Each has five 600-tick rounds per scenario; exclude the first 120 ticks per round. 4,800 measured ticks per scenario per version. No concurrent tests or artificial CPU throttling; other OS activity and thermal variation are uncontrolled. Native CPU rendering is not browser/GPU FPS.

rematchLifecycle.methodology: Node simulation lifecycle audit, not browser/GPU memory. 120 independent rematch opens, four three-second input sequences and resets per open. Exact fresh-body/pair/projectile counts after every reset; no saved progress. Heap sampled after explicit GC if available.

before.note: Simulation-only lifecycle soak; not browser FPS, human difficulty, or low-end hardware acceptance. Maxima sampled once per simulated second. Heap sampled after identical room resets and explicit GC when available.
